title: Octopuses have THREE hearts?! 🐙 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. said he knows EVERYTHING… big mistake. 🤖
Fizzo brought three facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #robot #shorts
facts_checked: An octopus has three hearts: two pump blood through the gills, one pumps it around the body.
Wombats produce cube-shaped poop (explained by a 2018 study of their intestines).
Venus spins so slowly that one rotation (about 243 Earth days) takes longer than one orbit around the Sun (about 225 Earth days).
